purpose: Teach: 羽根/遊戯/製図/海面/浴室/祖父母/出稼ぎ/蔵書

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、お正月に羽根つきやったろ?
lines.en: Riku — did you play badminton over New Year's?
lines.style: Quick, testing tone. Leaning in with genuine curiosity, not performing. Eyes bright. Rhythm conversational, not rushed.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前ん家、子供時代に遊戯室あったろ?桜
lines.en: Your place had a game room when you were little, didn't it? Sakura?
lines.style: Matching her energy but slightly defensive — gentle counterattack. Observant. Not accusatory, just turning the mirror back. Soft on her name.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前のお父さん、製図の仕事だろ?
lines.en: Riku — your dad does technical drafting, right?
lines.style: Pressing in. Each detail deliberate, like placing cards on a table. Testing what he'll admit. Warm underneath but sharp on the surface.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、海面で釣りしたろ?桜
lines.en: You've gone fishing off the coast before, haven't you? Sakura?
lines.style: Quiet, observant. Not backing down. Settling in like he's known this all along. Patient rhythm. Almost gentle with her name.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前ん家、浴室広いんだろ?
lines.en: Riku — your bathroom is pretty spacious, isn't it?
lines.style: Lighter touch now. Still curious but with a hint of playfulness creeping in. Searching. Testing the boundary between observation and assumption.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、祖父母にお小遣いもらったろ?桜
lines.en: You get spending money from your grandparents, don't you? Sakura?
lines.style: Calm, knowing. Not mean — just holding up what he's already figured out. His name for her soft but steady. He's been patient.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、社会で出稼ぎ労働の単元やったろ?
lines.en: Riku — you studied migrant labor in social studies, right?
lines.style: The pieces clicking audibly. Faster tempo now. Almost excited — not because she's caught him but because the pattern makes sense. Direct and bright.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前ん家、蔵書多いな、桜
lines.en: Your home library is pretty impressive, Sakura.
lines.style: Gentle confirmation. Warm admiration underneath. Slowing down here — this one feels real, not testing. Her name carries affection.
